blocks.text: Match preview: South Africa face Australia in 1st Test (TEST) on Fri, 9 Oct, 2026, 1:00 pm at Kingsmead Durban. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Bouncy South African surfaces; seam movement early, flatten for batters later.
Light drizzle · High 28°C / Low 20°C · Rain: 0.9 mm · Wind: up to 18 km/h. Light rain possible — overcast conditions could assist swing bowling early.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
